requires: the target is an explicitly identified GitHub repository
the user explicitly requests a plugin test or audit
the caller can either dispatch the workflow or create an isolated runtime/** request branch
do_not_use_for: ordinary repository inspection or advisory review
a standalone ZIP, pasted code, or local folder without a GitHub repository target
a private target while this harness repository is public

request.request_id_rule: Generate a unique value for every requested run; never reuse the previous request_id.
request.persistence_rule: Concrete request state is forbidden on the default branch. File-backed requests may exist only on an isolated runtime/** branch and should be removed after the run evidence is secured.

profile_routing.selection_policy: Use an exact registered repository binding or an exact registered plugin identity. If no specialized binding matches, select base. If multiple specialized profiles conflict, fail closed.
profile_routing.specialized_tool_policy: Product-specific services, PHP extensions, WordPress plugins, browser tooling, provider mocks and runtime probes may run only when declared by the resolved repository-owned profile.

execution: Resolve and verify the target repository, ref and plugin path before execution.
For workflow_dispatch, pass request fields directly as workflow inputs; do not persist a request file on main.
For a connector-driven file request, create a unique runtime/** branch from current main and write the complete request only to .audit/request.json on that branch.
Read back the runtime-branch request and commit SHA before interpreting the triggered run.
Never write concrete request state to main or another persistent capability branch.
Locate the Full WordPress Plugin Audit run associated with the dispatch or runtime-branch request.
Run the generic base audit for every target.
Resolve the plugin profile after target checkout and record the profile fingerprint and capabilities.
Run specialized services and probes only when a validated specialized profile matched; unknown plugins remain base-only.
Re-resolve and fingerprint the profile immediately before a specialized runtime job to prevent stale or switched profile execution.
Inspect job outcomes and all run-scoped artifacts before interpreting findings.
Treat scanner failures as candidate findings; wordpressqualityarchitect confirms or rejects bugs against the applicable oracle.
Do not describe a green source/controlled-runtime audit as staging, production, browser/device or provider proof.
